ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels against 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions dominate the lateral sections of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixel clusters are concentrated along the trailing edges, the median notch area, and as stippled mottling throughout the right lobe (viewer perspective).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 45-degree interior angle and a depth of ~12% of the vertical span of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations consisting of high-frequency pixel variations; distinct jagged peaks and valleys are visible along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the posterior edge, tapering into sharp upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, high-intensity white pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, suggesting calcified surface protrusions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous low-intensity linear pixel streaks (parallel and intersecting) cutting across the high-intensity white regions on both lobes, particularly prominent on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive network of parallel linear rake-mark scars across the ventral surface and thick calcified-looking clusters on the fluke tips.
